scope: Runtime code, database schema and migrations, API compatibility, persisted frontend state, Electron migration and backup compatibility, package shims, tests, generated contracts, and historical documentation.
searches: Name scan for legacy, deprecated, compatibility, backward, fallback, old-version, alias, shim, migration, and v1 markers outside generated/build output
Static importer and symbol-use scan for every seeded compatibility surface and every remove-now candidate
Schema-object scan across the fresh baseline, forward migrations, archived revisions, manual contracts, backup coverage, database tests, and runtime SQL
OpenAPI deprecated-operation and parameter scan followed through backend handlers, frontend clients, and generated types
Persisted-state scan across PostgreSQL, server settings, localStorage, Electron userData, runtime markers, and backup formats
False-positive review for fallbacks, Skeleton components, historical ADRs, archived migrations, rollback scripts, and formula-lineage comments
